Last updated: 21 April 2026 Takes 46 minutes to read Europe’s large food and beverage industry needs natural additives for many applications. Consumers dislike artificial ingredients and have a preference for clean labels. This feeling has grown stronger due to recent EU bans on synthetic ingredients such as smoke flavourings and titanium dioxide. The EU now also requires a warning label for artificial dyes. This is pushing manufacturers to use natural alternatives, creating good opportunities for exporters of natural sweeteners, hydrocolloids, essential oils, oleoresins and colourants. Germany, France, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Spain and Italy offer the strongest market opportunities. Contents
